protocol.unlabeled_interface_corpus: balanced seen-only corpus over five seen operations and seven grammar variants
protocol.position_free_span_inference: replace each candidate two-token span by an abstract command placeholder and score against grammar skeletons learned from the unlabeled corpus; local observed-bigram support is tie-break evidence
protocol.semantic_grounding: fixed behavior probes mapping opaque code behavior to anonymous source behavior
protocol.admission_threshold: fit only from five seen source/operator behavior pairs
protocol.fusion: source private sequence likelihood -> common 32-action probability -> primary/secondary probability mixture

failed_v1_diagnostic.failure: local observed-bigram span score alone selected operand-adjacent spans in grammar variants where replacing them with a command was locally plausible
failed_v1_diagnostic.scientific_effect: isolated the remaining failure to interface span discovery; source competence, private ABI recovery and behavioral source admission were not the cause
failed_v1_diagnostic.fix: learn full command-placeholder grammar skeletons from the unlabeled seen-only corpus and use structural distance before local bigram tie-breaking

claim_boundary: Controlled 32-state synthetic neural screen. All seven grammar variants are represented in the unlabeled seen-only corpus. Behavioral probes still provide expected common actions. A common action domain and stage boundaries remain externally supplied. This is not yet unrelated pretrained-LLM fusion.
